title: Mortar and Pestle Large Set - Laevo Black Granite Stone Spice Grinder, 2.1 Cup Capacity, 5.5 Inches - Reversible Molcajete Mexicano - Guacamole, Spices - Large Mortar and Pestles Set
description:
About this item
Durability and Stability: Crafted from solid granite; this mortar and pestle offers a durable, heavyweight design; 17 oz capacity; ensures stability for grinding spices, herbs, and more with ease
Includes Spoon and Lid: Comes with a spoon and silicone lid that doubles as a placemat; protect your countertop; keep ingredients fresh while preparing pestos, salsas, and more with your mortar pestle
Reversible Design: Features a unique reversible design; separate flavors and spices in one set; ideal for preparing various dishes like guacamole, pesto, or grinding spices in your molcajete mexicano
Unpolished and Non-Porous: Unpolished surface for optimal grinding; non-porous granite prevents absorption; ideal for making healthy homemade meals with this versatile pestle and mortar set
Thoughtful Gift Idea: A gift in stylish packaging; suitable for chefs and home cooks alike; ideal for housewarming, birthdays, and special occasions; durable and practical mortar and pestle sets
reviews_5s:
This being my first mortar and pestle, I can't testify to ease of use and such. But while I'm still hyped on receiving it, I'm gonna discuss the things I like and, over time I will be putting this to the test. A lot. Since I've read some people get a few months down the road and then disaster strikes, I will be keen to come back and update.
What I personally like, that seems to set this apart from others I've seen, is while there's that extra, small, shallow mortar on the bottom (unique by itself) I like that they made the edge of that rough. It IS still a base, after all. But they could have went and polished it like the exterior of the main bowl, thus making it more flashy, so I respect them making it rough. The little spoon is cute, and I'm sure I'll find a use. And while I can get infinite recipes online, it is always pleasant to find one in the box. A quick reference on the corkboard in the kitchen can be a lifesaver.
Now I will say this pestle seems to have a more rounded tip (on the side you use in the main bowl). I can't say how this will work, but it seems like it might make round ingredients difficult. This is something I'll have to test, though other reviewers say this works swell for peppercorn.I Love the new addition to my kitchen. This item is well made and sturdy. The grip mat makes it easier to use,no more slipping on the counter. It is also easy to wash and dry. The small size makes it easy to leave out on the counter.Very satisfying, the size is large enough to make good guacamole and the weight holds it in place without skipping around while you are making something. Looking fabulous! Stone solid and durable, great design.Excellent. Easy to use. Heavy and does not tip over.Excellent product, exactly what I was looking forPerfect and exactly what we were looking for.This is an awesome piece of kitchen equipment.

It has two different bowls within the same block of stone which allows you to grind up spices using different methods. The pestle is a great weight and allows for smooth grinding motions.

Pros:
Well Made
Coarse enough to grind down all spices
Not to large that it becomes a pain to move around
Rubber mat is useful and keeps the product in place
Looks great on a counter top

Cons:
Nothing really to complain about here.

Overall it is an awesome product at a reasonable price!This is a really delightful mortal and pestle. I have owned a few and they generally feel like a utility device. This is one I look forward to using. I love that it is reversible, and the little lid is surprisingly useful for keeping guac from browning. 10/10I received the granite mortar & pestle and was pleasantly surprised.

Not often do I find a cookware supplier with a high quality product, packed well (and even including a recipe), at a very competitive price. And frosting on the cake, they included an e-mail address to report any issues and with a promise to replace immediately if needed.

Yep – these folks are the best!Love the flip design...very heavy...well made.
reviews_1s:
Original Review:
I really liked the look, quality and many functions of this item. I wanted so bad to get a good one. I also read the numerous reviews talking about big cracks and broken parts. Well it happened to me. As you can see from the pics I put up there is an obvious crack starting on top going down the side and ending back about 3 inches away on top once again. You can see where someone tried to repair it on the side not a very good one (I could still feel the crack) but one on the start and ending cracks on the top were not repaired at all. If it were just one small crack repaired I would have been OK with it but really 3 to 4 inch crack. If it was used I might of bought it for less, but I'm not taking a chance that the side will fall off someday.
I'm returning it and giving 1 star not because it not a good item, but because they tried to slide one by me and have me go to UPS to return it. I'm not reordering it. Instead I'm ordering a very similar one with the white and black marble look for $.50 more and hoping it's not cracked. If so I'll order the granite one. Cross your fingers for me.
Updated Review
Well it's 3 days later and my new Mortar and Pestle that I reordered is here. It's not the same color scheme. It's more white and black marble look. Mostly white. This one is in perfect condition and all the items and bonus items arrived with it as well. Made by the same company. I'm a much happier camper with the new one. Hoping they sell the other one as a damaged deal. Some people just won't go the extra mile by returning it by driving to UPS and reordering a new one. Good luck if you still want to buy this dark colored one. Seems like the darker material is more fragile.It was received with a broken pestle. I'm scared to try to use it, in case it falls apart. I am reaching out to ask for replacement of the pestlePestle quality is not good as it started chipping out. I didn’t expect this at all initially when i started using.
FYI. I just used it for raw ginger root, pepper and cardamom few months ago.See the picture that compares this M&P (on the right) with another brand.

1. SHORT PESTLE. This Pestle is too short and I ended up busting my knuckles a few times.

2. SMALL RADIUS. In addition, the Pestle's grinding side that's meant for the deeper side of the Mortar, has a surface with a very small radius. This results in more difficulty in grinding when using the circular motion for crushing (as opposed to up-down).

3. TWO SIDES NOT USEFUL. Practically speaking, one would rarely use the bottom side of the mortar since it is so shallow that food will bounce out easily. Besides, the deeper side is just as easy to use (in fact easier as you don't have to flip the heavy unit) even for smaller quantities of food.

I finally ended up buying this one: https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B06W2KBC4Z/Not sure how to contact seller but, for no reason, the mortar is chipping all the way around the inside rim. It’s been used ever so gently.I bought his thinking good things and then... it broke while making pesto... yep crushing little old basil leaves... I hope they respond to this review. They didn't when I tried other avenues.

......Hmmm can't get a response from the seller.... it broke and is past the time of return....3 months of ownership now2 months and 2 days after purchase the pestle chipped, cracked, then crumbled in the same use. Only use was guacamole, if it cannot handle mashing avocados long term, then it most definitely cannot work with harder materials.The first time I ordered it came damaged with a large CRACK down the middle. I returned the item and received a replacement the next day which WAS ALSO DAMAGED. 2 times and both damaged… not much else to sayPestle had an awful smell straight from the box. On closer inspection there was a big brown spot on the end. After rinsing it, there is still a small stain. The black plastic piece had fingerprints and scratches on it.

I'm fairly tired of used/returned products being sent as new. I've continually done business else where over it.This product is made of marble, it came in pieces, I never dared to take it out of the box as it can have very sharp edges.
A slip of paper on top of box offered to ship a new one for free if broken.
No guarantee, even if it's one piece, if you break it while using you can cut yourself.
